title: House robber
statement: Houses in a row hold the given amounts; you can't rob two adjacent houses. Return the maximum total.
hints: dp[i] = best using the first i houses. What are the two options for house i?
dp[i] = max(dp[i−1], dp[i−2] + nums[i]); only two values are needed.

solution.explanation: State: the best total for a prefix. Transition: skip house i (dp[i−1]) or take it (dp[i−2] + x). Only the last two states are read, so keep two variables. Greedy (take every other house) fails on [2, 1, 1, 2], which is why this is DP.
